item.title: Alaska storm scattered artifacts; archaeologists race to save remains
item.description: A typhoon last year damaged homes, infrastructure, and an archaeological dig site. Archaeologists are now working to recover as many objects as possible.

item.title: U.S. and Denmark agree to expand U.S. military presence in Greenland
item.description: President Trump says he has reached a deal with Denmark to strengthen the U.S. military presence in Greenland, following months of threats.

item.title: Italy sees wider West Nile virus spread as Europe warms
item.description: Italian health authorities cite evidence that rising temperatures and longer warm seasons are enabling mosquitoes to spread West Nile virus across a broader area.

item.title: Understanding How the Fed's Interest Rate Works
item.description: The Federal Reserve raised interest rates this week for the first time this year. Here is how it works and what it means for the economy.
